## Featured Projects

- [StreamXT](https://github.com/Abhaysoft-inc/streamxt): Low-latency WebRTC streaming platform enabling real-time broadcasting with sub-second delay (under 1s). Built using Next.js, WebRTC, FFmpeg, and Docker with parallel local recording via MediaRecorder API.
- [Curalynx](https://curalynx.me) ([GitHub](https://github.com/ishaancreates/CuralynX)): AI-powered clinical documentation platform converting doctor-patient conversations into structured SOAP notes and EHR summaries. Backend engineered with FastAPI, Whisper / Faster-Whisper, speaker diarization, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and PostgreSQL.
- [Githall](https://github.com/Abhaysoft-inc/githall): Self-hosted Git server built in Go and Next.js supporting 100+ repositories over HTTP. Handled raw Git HTTP protocols (git-http-backend, go-git) and RESTful management APIs via Gin.
- [Thatlytics](https://github.com/Abhaysoft-inc/thatlytics): Analytics platform processing 10k+ events/day with real-time analytics dashboards using TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
